about: Targets come from what rival papers report. Each row is filled by Loop 4 from a page it read. The drawing script computes the target as the best rival number, published or reproduced, moved one step past it.

targets.metric: Images with 5 objects in correct locations (count of 100)
targets.protocol: Location-conditioned CLEVR at 128x128; 100 samples per composition method, with objects in correct locations counted by hand; EDM2 edm2-img64-xs U-net re-implementation; 65 model calls with a 32-step Heun sampler; no guidance.

Shapes3D at 64x3x3 with six attributes; U-Net trained with the DDPM linear schedule over 1000 noise steps; DDIM sampling with 100 steps; CS from a ResNet-18 multi-head attribute classifier trained on full support; R2 is the variance-weighted pixel comparison with the unique reference image; JSD over the first two attributes; composition tasks evaluated on unseen compositions under orthogonal partial support. Theoretical CoInD rows minimize the upper bound Eq. (10) with K1 = 1 and K2 = 0.1; the other CoInD rows minimize Eq. (11).

CMNIST U-Net at 28 x 28 with a ResNet-18 attribute classifier; the conformity score is the percentage of samples satisfying the query, averaged over 10,000 samples from 100 unique queries per task type with 100 samples each; N=2 to 5 are random formulas with N AND/OR operators; DDPM sampling with 50 timesteps as listed in Table 9.

SDv1.5 fine-tuned on CelebA with labels converted to text, all compositions except male and smiling; joint prompt "Photo of a smiling male celebrity"; ∧ of "Photo of a smiling celebrity" and "Photo of a male celebrity"; ¬ of "Photo of a smiling celebrity" and "Photo of a female celebrity".

T2I-CompBench (6,000 compositional prompts over 6 sub-categories) run with its default settings and the latest evaluation code on GitHub; the paper does not name the scorer or state the evaluated split, images per prompt, seeds, sampler, steps, guidance or resolution.

T2I-CompBench with 300 validation prompts per subset, scored by BLIP-VQA and ImageReward; GPT-4o Benchmark of 50 prompts scored by GPT-4o; ToMe updates the composite token in the first 20% of denoising steps on SDXL; image count, seeds and resolution not stated.

T2I-CompBench with 300 validation prompts per subset, scored by BLIP-VQA and ImageReward; GPT-4o Benchmark of 50 prompts scored by GPT-4o; ToMe updates the composite token in the first 20% of denoising steps on SDXL; image count, seeds and resolution not stated.

SDXL Base 1.0 with the VAE fix at 1024x1024, deterministic DDIM, 50 steps, guidance scale 5.0, empty negative prompt, for RTD and the controlled SDXL comparisons; each other baseline uses the guidance rule and hyperparameters of its official implementation; three fixed seeds per prompt, mean reported; one NVIDIA H200 GPU; RTD uses one update at t_pilot=980 with rho=0.02; 1,000 T2I-CompBench complex prompts; concepts from benchmark annotations; ImageReward (IR) and Human Evaluation (HE); S-IoU5 is the mean pairwise soft IoU of concept attention maps at denoising step 5. Human Evaluation (HE): 11 participants rate prompt-image agreement from 0 to 5 on every seed, prompt and method, with method names hidden and display order randomized; ratings are divided by 5 and averaged across participants and seeds.

SDXL Base 1.0 with the VAE fix at 1024x1024, deterministic DDIM, 50 steps, guidance scale 5.0, empty negative prompt, for RTD and the controlled SDXL comparisons; each other baseline uses the guidance rule and hyperparameters of its official implementation; three fixed seeds per prompt, mean reported; one NVIDIA H200 GPU; RTD uses one update at t_pilot=980 with rho=0.02; 120 RareBench prompts in Concat, Relations and Complex; concepts from Stanza noun phrases; ImageReward (IR) and Human Evaluation (HE); S-IoU5 is the mean pairwise soft IoU of concept attention maps at denoising step 5. Human Evaluation (HE): 11 participants rate prompt-image agreement from 0 to 5 on every seed, prompt and method, with method names hidden and display order randomized; ratings are divided by 5 and averaged across participants and seeds.

Image generation with SDXL and classifier-free guidance scored on the GenEval benchmark; mean values are reported and no arrow is printed on any column, so the direction comes from GenEval scores being accuracies; a starred row is taken directly from the GenEval leaderboard rather than run by the authors. This row: run by the authors at guidance weight beta = 7.5.
